notes: Component list for the L4D2 8-Player Co-op Manager. Based on fbef0102's '8+ Survivors In Coop' guide (updated 2026-07-26). Put an edited copy named components.json next to the .exe to override this embedded one.

components.name: Metamod:Source 1.12 (stable)
components.description: Plugin loader that SourceMod and L4DToolZ run on top of.

components.name: SourceMod 1.12 (stable)
components.description: Server plugin framework. Every 8-player fix below is a SourceMod plugin.

components.name: L4DToolZ (lakwsh) - player limit unlocker
components.description: Removes the engine's player cap and lobby reservation limit (sv_setmax / sv_maxplayers).

components.name: Left 4 DHooks Direct (SilverShot)
components.description: Shared hook library that nearly every L4D2 plugin depends on.

components.name: Actions extension
components.description: Extension used by the infected-targeting fix for 5+ survivors. Pinned to v3.9.2, the last release built for SourceMod 1.12 (v4.x needs 1.13). Taken from the official release: some server-pack mirrors ship the TF2 build under the L4D2 name, which fails to load.

components.name: Source Scramble extension (nosoop)
components.description: Memory-patching extension that the Charger collision fix needs.

components.name: l4d_CreateSurvivorBot
components.description: Spawns the extra survivor bots that players 5-8 take over.

components.name: l4dmultislots (Harry version)
components.description: Gives players 5+ their own survivor. This is the 8-player co-op plugin itself.

components.name: l4d_unreservelobby (Harry version)
components.description: Removes the 4-player lobby reservation once the lobby is full so players 5-8 can connect.

components.name: Items For 5+ Survivors (built in)
components.description: Maps are stocked for 4. This scales weapon piles, melee weapons, throwables and healing items (kits, pills, adrenaline, defibs) with the survivors, bots included. Auto: x survivors / 4, so with 8 survivors a pile of 5 holds 10 and each kit or pills spawn can be taken twice. Half, Custom (your own % per category) or Off are set with 'More items for 5+' on the Play tab. Survivors joining mid-chapter top up what's left; nothing is taken away when they leave. Per-category on/off and the cap in cfg/sourcemod/l4d2_8p_items.cfg.

components.name: Infected For 5+ Survivors (built in)
components.description: The director is tuned for 4, so 8 survivors walk through it. This scales how many special infected can be alive at once, the common horde and mob sizes, and Tank health with the survivors, bots included. Auto: x survivors / 4 (8 survivors: 4 specials at once instead of 2, hordes of 60 instead of 30, an 8000 HP Tank on Normal). Half, Custom (your own % rules, including faster special respawns) or Off are set with 'Harder infected for 5+' on the Play tab. Co-op, realism and survival only. Caps in cfg/sourcemod/l4d2_8p_infected.cfg.

components.name: Campaign Rotation (built in)
components.description: A dedicated server sits on the finale after the rescue. This moves on to another campaign a few seconds into the credits: the next one in order, a random one, or one the players vote for (also any time with !mapvote), set with 'After the finale' on the Play tab. Custom campaigns installed on the server join the rotation after the official ones. Optional: move on after a number of finale wipes (l4d2_8p_rotation_wipes). Admins can skip ahead with sm_nextcampaign. Co-op and realism.

components.name: Defib Fix (Lux)
components.description: Defibs revive the correct survivor when characters are duplicated.

components.name: Survivor AFK Fix (Lux)
components.description: Going idle no longer swaps you onto another bot with the same character.

components.name: l4dafkfix_deadbot
components.description: Idle players take over their dead bot instead of becoming a full spectator.

components.name: l4d_both_fixUpgradePack
components.description: Lets every survivor pick up ammo upgrade packs when there are 5+ survivors.

components.name: Charger Collision patch (Lux)
components.description: Chargers can hit duplicate survivor characters.

components.name: Witch Target patch (Lux)
components.description: Witches chase the survivor who startled them, not a clone of that character.

components.name: l4d2_trigger_flow_fix
components.description: Stops custom maps from softlocking when survivor models are mixed.

components.name: l4d2_vocalizebasedmodel
components.description: Survivors talk based on their model, which prevents stuck finale conversations.

components.name: l4d2_fix_changelevel (Forgetest)
components.description: Fixes problems caused by forced map changes.

components.name: l4d2_transition_info_fix
components.description: Clears stale transition data after a map change.

components.name: Command and ConVar Buffer Overflow Fixer (SilverShot)
components.description: Stops large plugin configs from overflowing the command buffer.

components.name: spawn_infected_nolimit
components.description: Required by the map tank fix.

components.name: l4d2_maptankfix
components.description: Makes scripted map tanks spawn when the infected slots are full.

components.name: l4d2_rescue_vehicle_multi
components.description: Counts survivors 5+ as rescued when the finale vehicle leaves.

components.name: Ladder Server Crash patch (SilverShot)
components.description: Prevents a server crash in NavLadder::GetPosAtHeight.

components.name: l4d2_fix_character_mixed (Forgetest)
components.description: Prioritizes character searching so 8+ survivors keep the right characters.

components.name: l4d_full_slot_bot_replace_fix
components.description: Fixes bots failing to take over when the server is out of slots.

components.name: l4d_fix_target_replace (Forgetest)
components.description: Infected keep a valid target when survivors are replaced by bots or players.

components.name: Keep Verified Players (built in)
components.description: Stops 'No Steam logon' kicks (STEAMAUTH code 8) for players Steam already verified. These hit the host about a minute after joining their own server from the same PC, and anyone after a reconnect. Unverified players are still dropped.

components.name: Unique Survivors (built in)
components.description: Gives each of up to 8 survivors their own character, the L4D1 cast included (Nick, Rochelle, Coach, Ellis, Bill, Zoey, Francis, Louis), instead of bot fill's copies. Players pick theirs with !char (a menu that also opens when they join), the host's pick from the Play tab is kept for them, and everyone keeps their character across chapters. Also keeps the L4D1 cast out of their calm animations, which hold several weapons straight up through the body. Settings in cfg/sourcemod/l4d2_8p_characters.cfg.

components.name: Survivor Identity Fix for 5+ (Jackz build of Merudo/Shadowysn)
components.description: Keeps survivors from swapping character when players join or leave. This is a community-modified build; the original is only on the AlliedModders forum.

components.name: l4d2_ty_saveweapons
components.description: Survivors 5+ lose their weapons and items at every chapter change (the game only carries over the first four). This saves and restores them. On L4D2 it also needs Transition Restore Fix, which is a forum-only download (Setup tab > Forum-only extras); without it, only some items come back. Installs l4d_heartbeat and l4d_transition_entity with it.

components.name: l4d_heartbeat (needed by l4d2_ty_saveweapons)
components.description: Keeps each survivor's black-and-white state and revive count right. Installed with l4d2_ty_saveweapons, which needs it.

components.name: l4d_transition_entity (Forgetest, needed by l4d2_ty_saveweapons)
components.description: Carries entities across a map transition. Installed with l4d2_ty_saveweapons, which needs it.

components.name: AutoTakeOver 5+ Survivors
components.description: When you die, you automatically take over a free alive bot.

components.name: Skip the welcome screen (built in)
components.description: Players join straight into the game, without the server's message-of-the-day panel ("This third-party server provided by") that they otherwise have to close first. Untick it, or set l4d2_8p_nomotd_enable 0 in cfg/sourcemod/l4d2_8p_nomotd.cfg, to show it again.

components.name: 8-survivor HUD (built in)
components.description: Lists the survivors the stock HUD has no panel for (6-8) under the weapon slots, with health and state (down, ledge, pinned, B&W, dead); also visible on the Tab screen. Plain text by default, which needs nothing on the players' PCs. With 'HUD bars + icons' on (Play tab) it draws dark boxes with health bars coloured by state and the game's own kit/pills icons; every player then needs the small HUD add-on, which the Manager and the Join app install. While it's on, the game runs in 'challenge mode' (needed for the HUD to draw), which can stop some achievements like a mutation does. Settings in cfg/sourcemod/l4d2_8p_hud.cfg.

components.name: 8-Player HUD add-on (your game)
components.description: The small client add-on (left4dead2\addons\l4d2_8p_hud.vpk) that lets the 8-survivor HUD draw health bars, status labels and the game's item icons ('HUD bars + icons' on the Play tab). It goes into your own game, not the server, so close Left 4 Dead 2 before installing it. Every player needs it for that look: friends install it from the Join app.

manual.name: Transition Restore Fix
manual.why: Restores items and health across map changes by player instead of character. AlliedModders forum download only.

manual.name: InputKill Kick Prevention
manual.why: Fixes the 'Kicked by Console : CBaseEntity::InputKill()' error. AlliedModders forum download only.

manual.name: Survivor Identity Fix (original Shadowysn post)
manual.why: The upstream version of the optional identity fix.

workshop.name: 8 Slots Lobby Mod
workshop.why: Gives the in-game lobby 8 slots. Only the host needs it. Side effect: ESC > Idle stops working.

workshop.name: 8 Player Modified Talker
workshop.why: Dialogue for L4D1 and L4D2 survivors playing together.

conflictingPlugins.reason: SuperVersus is another survivor-slot manager. Running it next to l4dmultislots spawns duplicate bots and breaks team limits.
Bebop is another co-op slot manager. It conflicts with l4dmultislots.
l4d2_rmc (lakwsh) is another multi-slot plugin. Use it or l4dmultislots, not both.
Older MultiSlots variant. It conflicts with the installed l4dmultislots.
Character Manager changes the survivor set and can softlock maps. The 8+ guide says not to install it.
Left4Fix is broken on the current game version.
Dialogue Criteria Fix has been broken since the 2023/05 game update.
Real Survivor Mourn Fix has been broken since the 2023/05 game update.
L4DToolZ already unlocks tickrate. Running tickrate_enabler too can conflict.

conflictingExtensions.reason: Left4Downtown2 is obsolete and crashes current servers. Left 4 DHooks replaces it.
Old ivailosp L4DToolZ build. It conflicts with the lakwsh L4DToolZ that 8-player needs.
